about: The weather sounds: 48 kHz 16-bit mono WAVs, every file's peak at -1 dBFS. Play a sound at its "gain" (multiply) so the set is levelled against itself: swings under hits, hits under heavy hits, the finishing blow the loudest. Pick one of the files at random each time. loud_db: the loudest 50 ms of the file before the gain; target_db: where it should sit (the sword's hit = about 0).

rain_light_a.use: the shower and light rain: a seamless 16 s loop (two takes); the game crossfades the beds by the weather's strength
rain_light_a.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -16 dB relative to it

rain_a.use: steady rain on the ground: a seamless 16 s loop
rain_a.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -12 dB relative to it

rain_heavy_v.use: the storm's driven rain: a seamless 16 s loop (the studio's, layered from the others)
rain_heavy_v.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -8 dB relative to it

rain_water_a.use: rain on water near the shore: a seamless 16 s loop
rain_water_a.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -14 dB relative to it

thunder_a.use: far thunder after a flash, broad long rolls; the game lowers it with the delay
thunder_a.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -4 dB relative to it

thunder_b.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -4 dB relative to it
